  • Method Details

    • findLiveListings

      public List<Listing> findLiveListings() throws SQLException
      Returns every live listing card, newest first.

      Only LIVE listings owned by an active SELLER are included. Each result carries just the first saved photo as a thumbnail, not the full gallery. Uses one connection from the provider.

      Returns:
      the live listing cards; never null
      Throws:
      SQLException - when the query fails

      • findVisibleById(String, String)

    • findVisibleById

      public Listing findVisibleById(String id, String viewer) throws SQLException
      Returns a buyer-visible listing, counts one view atomically, and loads up to six photos.

      Visible statuses are LIVE, RESERVED, SOLD, LENT and GIVEN, and the seller must be an active SELLER. A guarded view-count update runs first, so a missing or no-longer-visible listing returns null without loading photos. The work runs in a repeatable-read transaction owned and committed by this method. row_version is deliberately not changed, so views never invalidate a seller's optimistic-lock check. Agreed deal terms are attached only when viewer is the buyer on the accepted/completed deal.

      Parameters:
      id - the listing ID
      viewer - the buyer username used to attach agreed terms, or null for none
      Returns:
      the listing with its photos, or null when it is not visible
      Throws:
      SQLException - when any statement fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • reportListing

      public String reportListing(String buyer, String listingId, String reason) throws SQLException
      Records a buyer's report against a visible listing and returns the reported title.

      Uses its own transaction. The buyer row is checked with FOR SHARE and must be an active BUYER; the visible listing row is then locked with FOR SHARE and must have an active SELLER. A report row is inserted and committed. No duplicate check is performed, so the same buyer may report a listing more than once, and no extra view is counted.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the reporting buyer's username
      listingId - the listing being reported
      reason - the free-text reason stored with the report as supplied
      Returns:
      the listing title captured at report time
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the buyer is not an active buyer or the listing is not visible to buyers
      SQLException - when any statement fails; the transaction is rolled back
